issues.failure_explanation: From the paper's own definitions, for w=u∘F_σ one has ∇(u∘F_σ)=(α_1(∂_1u)∘F_σ, α_2(∂_2u)∘F_σ) and hence ∂_{ν_σ}(u∘F_σ)=α_1(∂_νu)∘F_σ (explicitly, for the surface wave u=e^{iξx_1−Zx_2} one gets ∂_{ν_σ}(u∘F_σ)=α_1Z(u∘F_σ) on the flat part). Thus the physical relation ∂_νu+M_βu=g continues to ∂_{ν_σ}(u∘F_σ)+α_1M_β(u∘F_σ)=α_1g, not to (eq:pmlN-imp). Consequently (i) the complex-stretched extension E(f) used in lem:stretched-green-estimates does not satisfy (eq:layer-corr-imp), so the correction η_f=u_σ−E(f) in lem:neumann-dtn-perturbation/thm:pml-pde carries an unaccounted boundary source −(α_1−1)M_βE(f) on Σ_pml whose strength is O(σ_1) near the PML entrance where E(f)=O(1); and (ii) the Section 6 assertion that φ^∞_σ=u^∞_σ|_Σ solves (eq:complex-scaled-bie) is false, since that equation encodes ∂_{ν_σ}w=g−M_βw while the continued field obeys ∂_{ν_σ}w=α_1(g−M_βw). The DtN perturbation bound and the exponential PML convergence therefore are not obtained.

failure_location.quote: Applying Lemma~\ref{lem:neumann-layer-correction} with $r=-\partial_{\nu_\sigma}E(f)$ completes the proof.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace (eq:pmlN-imp) on the PML part of Γ_R by the correctly transformed relation ∂_{ν_σ}u_σ+α_1M_βu_σ=α_1g (equivalently use ν·diag(1/α_1,1/α_2)∇ in place of the A_σ-conormal there), propagate this change through the exact and computable layer operators and the layer-correction argument, and re-prove the PML-segment estimates; alternatively restrict the model to configurations in which the impedance boundary never enters a PML region.
issues.overall_effect: The exponential Neumann-PML-PDE convergence, the exact-BIE convergence and stability transfers that use it, the tail smallness of the exact density, and the final computable PML-BIE convergence guarantee all become unreliable for the stated formulation; the surface-wave contribution is reflected at the PML entrance rather than absorbed, so the error in the physical region need not decrease with σ̄.
issues.title: Impedance condition is not the PML transform of the physical condition
issues.why_classification: The defect is in the model problem, not in a local estimate: the stated PML problem is not the transformed physical problem, the source's own complex-scaled solution fails its boundary condition by the factor α_1, and the resulting surface-wave mismatch is not small at the PML entrance. Any complete resolution either abandons the advertised exponential convergence of the method exactly as defined or changes the boundary condition and hence the boundary integral equation, requiring a re-derivation of the operators and the layer analysis.

issues.failure_explanation: Lemma lem:Ainv-E-small needs ‖𝓔_σ h‖_{Y_R} ≤ C e^{−c_1σ̄}‖h‖ on the whole arc, but Proposition prop:reflected-kernel-estimate only treats K×Γ_R and Γ_R×Γ_R^int and explicitly states that its argument does not give an exponentially small operator-norm estimate on Γ_R×Γ_R; the alternative 'Hankel bound + Sobolev mapping' is only asserted. Moreover, 𝓔_σ = (𝓡_{σ,N} − G_σ^near) still contains the nearest vertical-boundary reflection wherever χ_im ≠ 1, and the definition only requires supp χ_im ⊂ the PML segments, not χ_im ≡ 1 near the endpoints ∂Γ_R where the nearest reflected source coalesces with the observation point and the kernel is singular.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Impose χ_im ≡ 1 in a neighbourhood of the endpoints ∂Γ_R (so that the whole nearest-image singular part is inside 𝓑_σ^im) and supply the missing kernel/Sobolev estimate showing that every remaining image term is O(e^{−cσ̄}) in operator norm on Γ_R×Γ_R, uniform in σ̄.
issues.overall_effect: The exponential smallness of the separated remainder, and hence the Neumann-series solvability and density/field convergence claims that rest on it, are unsupported near the endpoints of Γ_R as the cutoffs are defined.
issues.title: Operator-norm smallness of the separated remainder is asserted contrary to the source's own disclaimer
issues.why_classification: A local condition on the cutoff plus a contained kernel estimate repairs the gap without new global architecture and preserves all rates, but the required operator-norm estimate is exactly the one the source states it cannot obtain, so more than a routine edit is needed.

issues.failure_explanation: The reconstructed field u_σ^ni is defined only in Ω_p, so the H^1(K) statement for K ⊂ Ω_R is not even well posed; and the proof only combines the field comparison with Theorem thm:exact-conv, which (like (eq:pde-conv)) is restricted to K ⋐ Ω_p. The same overclaim recurs in Theorem thm:computable-convergence, whose proof likewise cites (eq:pde-conv). Inside the PML region the truncated solution approximates the damped complex-scaled continuation, not the outgoing solution u, so convergence on K ⋐ Ω_R ∖ Ω_p is false.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict both estimates to compact K ⋐ Ω_p (and define u_σ^ni on all of Ω_R if a Ω_R version is wanted), keeping the same rates.
issues.overall_effect: Both final field-error theorems promise accuracy up to the artificial boundary, a guarantee neither the reconstruction nor the invoked PML estimate provides; only compact subsets of the physical region are covered.
issues.title: Field error stated on all of Ω_R although only Ω_p is meaningful
issues.why_classification: The forced correction is local and keeps the method and the exponential rate, but it necessarily withdraws the advertised accuracy on the PML part of Ω_R, so the scope does not survive unchanged and the issue is more than minor.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof obtains ‖𝓢_σ^im q‖_{H^{1/2}} ≤ Cσ̄^{−1/2}‖q‖_{H^{1/2}} and then applies it to q = M_βχ_im φ, concluding ≤ Cσ̄^{−1/2}‖χ_im φ‖_{H^{1/2}}. This last step uses that multiplication by β maps H^{1/2}(Γ_R) to itself with norm controlled by ‖β‖, but only β ∈ L^∞ is assumed, and L^∞ multipliers are not bounded on H^{1/2}; a merely measurable admittance can destroy H^{1/2} regularity of M_β φ. The same unjustified multiplication is used in the weighted part (eq:Bim-weight-cancel).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Either assume β ∈ W^{1,∞}(Σ) (or Lipschitz) so that M_β is bounded on H^{1/2}, or re-run the endpoint-Hankel estimate interpolating the L^2→L^2 and L^2→H^1 bounds of 𝓗_μ and use only ‖M_βχ_im φ‖_{L^2} ≤ ‖β‖_∞‖χ_im φ‖_{L^2}.
issues.overall_effect: The σ̄^{−1/2} smallness of 𝓑_σ^im on Y_R, and therefore the contraction factor in the Neumann series and the density convergence rate, are not established for the stated admittance class.
issues.title: L^∞ multiplication used as bounded on H^{1/2}
issues.why_classification: Adding the standard local regularity condition on β (or the short alternative interpolation) preserves the method, the σ̄^{−1/2} rate and the advertised scope with no new lemma or reoptimization.
